discovery_candidates.title: Pb surface/deep enrichment screening in sediment (sediment_outlet_top vs sediment_outlet_bottom)
discovery_candidates.question: Is Pb systematically enriched or depleted in sediment_outlet_top relative to sediment_outlet_bottom at the same sites, and is the pattern anthropogenic or geogenic?
discovery_candidates.suggested_design: sites = coordinates rounded to 0.01 deg; per-site median within one method family; surface/deep ratio per site; report median ratio, bootstrap 95% CI, Wilcoxon signed-rank on log ratio; sensitivity: 0.1 deg grid and alternative method family; geogenic controls (Ni, Cr).
discovery_candidates.caveats: screening only; ratios conflate pedogenic redistribution with input history
